about_the_game:
When the front door isn’t enough… there’s always the Backdoor.

The Furry Do Porn – Backdoor DLC brings you over 50 brand new uncensored animations for the true connoisseurs of rear-guard action. This is a special expansion for players who demanded more, darker, and dirtier journeys into uncharted territory.

If you thought the original game was generous, wait until you unlock this chocolate-coated side quest. Play, collect, and enjoy — Backdoor is built for those who like their adventures bold and their pleasures unapologetic.

Highlights:

  • 50+ new explicit animations added to your library

  • A cheeky “rear-entry” expansion for hardcore fans

  • Seamlessly integrated into the base game

  • More variety, more spice, more reasons to stay inside

⚠️ Note: This DLC adds new content to the base game. You must own Furry Do Porn to enjoy the Backdoor experience.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains full nudity, explicit sexual acts, and anthropomorphic (furry) characters in adult scenes. All content is fictional, consensual, and features characters of legal age. No violent, non-consensual, or illegal themes are present.
